Recent changes

March 1, 2026

Bot API 9.5

  • Added the method getMe.

February 1, 2026

Bot API 9.4

Getting updates

getUpdates

Use this method to receive incoming updates. Returns an Array of Update objects.

Update

This object represents an incoming update.
At most one of the optional fields can be present in any given update.

FieldTypeDescription
update_idIntegerThe update's unique identifier.
messageMessageOptional. New incoming message.

Available types

User

This object represents a Telegram user or bot.

FieldTypeDescription
idIntegerUnique identifier for this user or bot.
is_premiumTrueOptional. True, if this user is a Telegram Premium user

Message

This object represents a message.

FieldTypeDescription
message_idIntegerUnique message identifier
entitiesArray of MessageEntityOptional. Special entities in the text

MessageEntity

This object represents one special entity in a text message.

FieldTypeDescription
typeStringType of the entity

MessageOrigin

This object describes the origin of a message. It can be one of

  • MessageOriginUser
  • MessageOriginChat

MessageOriginUser

The message was originally sent by a known user.

FieldTypeDescription
typeStringType of the message origin, always “user”
sender_userUserUser that sent the message originally

MessageOriginChat

The message was originally sent on behalf of a chat.

FieldTypeDescription
typeStringType of the message origin, must be chat

RichText

This object represents a rich formatted text. Currently, it can be either a String for plain text, an Array of RichText, or any of the following types:

  • RichTextBold

RichTextBold

A bold rich text.

FieldTypeDescription
typeStringType of the rich text, always “bold”
textRichTextThe text

InputMessageContent

This object represents the content of a message to be sent. It can be one of

  • InputTextMessageContent

InputTextMessageContent

Represents the content of a text message.

FieldTypeDescription
message_textStringText of the message to be sent, 1-4096 characters

CallbackGame

A placeholder, currently holds no information.

InputFile

This object represents the contents of a file to be uploaded.

Sending files

There are three ways to send files.

Available methods

getMe

A simple method for testing your bot's authentication token. Requires no parameters. Returns basic information about the bot in form of a User object.

sendMessage

Use this method to send text messages. On success, the sent Message is returned.

ParameterTypeRequiredDescription
chat_idInteger or StringYesUnique identifier for the target chat
photosArray of InputFile, String and IntegerOptionalA list
entitiesArray of MessageEntityOptionalSpecial entities

editMessageText

Use this method to edit text messages. On success, if the edited message is not an inline message, the edited Message is returned, otherwise True is returned.

getChatMemberCount

Use this method to get the number of members in a chat. Returns Int on success.
